learning_outcomes.text: Apply the fundamental laws of thermodynamics to physical systems

syllabus_topics: First Law of Thermodynamics for closed systems
Mass and energy analysis in volumes control
teaching_methods: Resolution of problems extracted from a book of problems
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of a theoretical test (15%), laboratory assignments (10%), and an examination (75%). The examination component's structure varies by period: the main exam period includes a theoretical mini-test (15% of exam grade) and a practical test (60% of final exam grade). For other exam periods, the exam is a theoretical test (30%) and a practical exam (60%), with lab evaluation remaining at 10%. Students must not exceed 25% absences in mandatory classes to be eligible for exams, and failing to appear for any component results in a zero grade.
